#!/bin/bash
# argv-logging shim for npm. Captures every `npm` invocation that happens
# while this dir is first on PATH, then execs the real npm so behavior is
# unchanged. Used to prove that `grok update` reads cli.npm_registry from
# config.toml and passes it as `--registry=...` to `npm install -g
# @xai-official/grok`.
#
# REAL_NPM and NPM_SHIM_LOG are provided by the Dockerfile.

LOG="${NPM_SHIM_LOG:-/tmp/npm-argv.log}"
TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)

{
  echo "==== ${TS} pid=$$ ppid=$PPID ===="
  echo "cwd: $(pwd)"
  echo "argc: $#"
  i=0
  for a in "$@"; do
    echo "argv[$i]=${a}"
    i=$((i+1))
  done
  echo "GROK_NPM_REGISTRY=${GROK_NPM_REGISTRY-<unset>}"
  echo "npm_config_registry=${npm_config_registry-<unset>}"
  echo "PATH=${PATH}"
  echo
} >> "$LOG"

exec "${REAL_NPM:-/usr/local/bin/npm}" "$@"
